project: Wuxia Life Early Childhood Preschool Content And Pacing (Stage-4)
description: Stage-4: thicken 3–7 year preschool content density, age-graduated lite planning for 5–7, narrative pacing (≥8 plot beats in 35 steps, placeholder ≤3), stat-delta narrative binding, and disturbance age guard. Product truth: docs/PRD/early-childhood-preschool-content-and-pacing.md; suite index docs/PRD/early-childhood-opening-experience-index.md.

userStories.title: Age-gated planning placeholder copy for ages 0–7
userStories.description: As a player, I should never see adult jianghu filler placeholder during infancy and preschool so that early life stays immersive.
acceptanceCriteria: resolvePlanningPlaceholderText(age) for age ≤7 never returns text containing「本期暂无强求的江湖变故，你可安排日常行动」
Ages 0–4 resolve to passive/home-season copy (e.g. 岁月静流 / 家中一季); ages 5–7 resolve to childhood framing (e.g. 童年时光)
App.vue planning-gap paths use resolvePlanningPlaceholderText(age) — no hardcoded adult placeholder for age ≤7
Unit or headless test asserts ages 0, 3, 5, 7 placeholder output excludes adult jianghu snippet
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-004 (split 1/2); §5 FR-4; §8 success metrics (0–4 placeholder 0); §3 frozen (3–4 no active_planning); touchpoints infantPassiveNarratives.ts, App.vue

userStories.title: Childhood planning intro framing in App.vue
userStories.description: As a player ages 5–7, I want planning intros to read as childhood seasons, not jianghu career optimization.
acceptanceCriteria: Ages 5–7 active_planning intro/title copy mentions childhood/home framing — not adult career or jianghu optimization language
Ages 0–4: zero occurrences of「本期暂无强求的江湖变故」in a sample 0→4 browser or scripted playthrough
Ages 5–7: placeholder frequency target ≤3 per 35 steps documented in test notes (full closure in US-012)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-004 (split 2/2); §5 FR-4; §8 (5–7 placeholder ≤3/35 steps); depends on US-001 resolver; non-goals §6 (no disturbance UI redesign)

userStories.title: Story-gap scheduling prefers passive or spine over planning

acceptanceCriteria: When selectEvent() returns null and age ≤7, session scheduler prefers passive narrative or queued spine before active_planning (age≥5 only)
Age 3 story gap does not enter active_planning — headless or unit test proves planningOptions.length === 0
Age 5–7 may enter lite active_planning only after passive/spine paths exhausted per scheduler
Document behavior and test commands in docs/test-reports/early-childhood-story-gap-stage4.md
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-001; §5 FR-1 (age 3–4 never planningOptions except bug); §9 priority after US-004; touchpoints GameEngineIntegration.selectEvent, HeadlessEngineSessionImpl.getSessionPhase, childhoodAgency.ts

userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-002 (split 1/4); §7 design considerations; non-goals §6 (no 8–12 P16 palette refactor, no bulk adult combat events)

userStories.title: Age band lite action pool definitions for 5–6 vs 7
userStories.description: As a developer, I want distinct lite action bands so 5-year-olds and 7-year-olds do not share an identical palette.
acceptanceCriteria: Define bands in childhoodAgency.ts or config: ages 5–6 vs age 7 with different lite action id sets or labels (e.g. 5岁「院中玩耍」→7岁「帮家里打杂」)
resolveChildhoodActionPalette respects band by player age; still max 2 options per planning period (FR-3, DAILY_PLANNING_MIN_AGE=5)
No adult P7 five-action minimum set surfaced in 5–7 band
Unit test: age 5 and age 7 palettes differ in id or label for at least one origin
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-003 (split 1/2); §3 frozen (lite palette max 2 categories); §5 FR-3; §7 (prefer copy/pool over new phase if PlanningOptionDto compatible); touchpoints childhoodAgency.ts, childhood action catalog

userStories.title: Origin-aware graduated lite palettes with browser verify
userStories.description: As a player, I want my available childhood actions to change as I grow from 5 to 7 with origin flavor.
acceptanceCriteria: Same origin save at age 5 vs age 7: palette ids are not identical for ≥2 origins (书香门第 + one other minimum)
Palette remains ≤2 options per planning period at ages 5–7
Browser or API playtest: age 5 and age 7 show different lite action labels or ids for sampled origin
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-003 (split 2/2); §8 success metric (5 vs 7 action pool not identical); §2 goals; depends on US-008 band definitions
